newsitem.title: CANADA: Rio Algom sees big boost from Chile find.
newsitem.headline: Rio Algom sees big boost from Chile find.

text.p: Rio Algom Ltd's discovery of another major copper deposit in Chile will likely allow the company to boost annual copper production levels to more than 900 million pounds, company officials said on Friday.
"It has the potential to bring our output to more than 900 million pounds a year," company chairman Gordon Gray told reporters. "So this is a big step. We're very excited about it."
The company said it expects production to be about 250 million pounds in 1996. Production should surpass 900 million pounds by 2001, said vice-president of development Ulrich Rath.
